### ¶ Nocturn.

**O** Lady, let the splendor of your face be my illumination: and may the serenity of your grace shine upon my mind. Lift up my head above my enemies and I will sing psalms: I will sing a psalm to your name. Do not turn your face away from me: for I have desired your hope and your beauty from my youth.
